rules.statement: An unregistered mortgage decree is void against a subsequently registered conveyance, and the plaintiff must establish both the debt and the charge as against the defendant in an action under section 247 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "Of course, it will be open to the plaintiff by a proper proceeding to render the land, of which they are owners, subject to the mortgage executable for the mortgage debt. But he must establish the debt and the charge as against them."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 247 of the Civil Procedure Code
